title: Coolify deployment — a shared dev backend and a full preview per pull request

tasks.title: Compose file, surface and relay images for Coolify, and the previews runbook

acs.text: WHEN `docker-compose.yaml` is read THE SYSTEM SHALL define the services `app`, `surface`, `relay` and `postgres`: `app` built from the repository's Dockerfile, applying the committed migrations before it serves and reaching the database and the relay by service name; `app`, `surface` and `relay` each asking Coolify for a public domain on the port it serves (`SERVICE_URL_<SERVICE>_<PORT>`); `postgres` an image pinned by tag and sha256 digest with a health check that `app` waits for; and every secret given as a `${VARIABLE}` reference (Coolify's generated `SERVICE_PASSWORD_*` or a variable set on the app), never a literal value
scenarios: AC-001 the compose file defines the four services

acs.text: WHEN the surface image is built THE SYSTEM SHALL build the surface with the release build, serve its `manifest.json` with `Cache-Control: no-cache` and its hashed files under `/assets/` as immutable, allow any origin on every response, run as a non-root user from base images pinned by tag and sha256 digest, and report its health from the manifest
scenarios: AC-002 the surface image serves the release build

acs.text: WHEN the relay image starts THE SYSTEM SHALL run the Worker in workerd from base images pinned by tag and sha256 digest, as a non-root user, taking `ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, `JWKS_URL`, `TOKEN_ISSUER` and `RELAY_INTERNAL_SECRET` from its environment at start (refusing to start when one is missing) and baking none of them into the image, and report its health from `/health`
scenarios: AC-003 the relay image runs the Worker from its environment
